title: Category names are unique ignoring capitals and need 3 characters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named for example Wheel Seals.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, named for example Brake Pads.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category B's row.
  3. Click the category name at the top of the page.
  4. Type category A's name in capitals (for example WHEEL SEALS).
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Open Settings › Categories.
  7. Click New Category.
  8. Type ab.
  9. Click Create Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category B is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category B's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name becomes editable.

Step 4:

  • The typed name shows.

Step 5:

  • An error reads "A category called", the typed name, "already exists".
  • Category B keeps its own name.

Step 6:

  • The Categories list shows category B under its own name.

Step 7:

  • The New Category page opens.

Step 8:

  • The field reads ab.

Step 9:

  • The category is not created: an error shows on the name field.
  • The New Category page stays open with ab in the field.
